newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END STEADY AT 19.625 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END STEADY AT 19.625 PCT.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates started the second week in the same range of between 19.625 and 19.875 percent in abundant money supply and moderate activity, dealers said.
Overnight rates closed at 19.625 percent, unchanged from Friday.
Traders expected the rates to remian steady for most of this week as well.
"I think overnight rates will probably remain unchanged," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Since the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period on August 1, overnight rates hovered in a narrow range between 19.50 and 20.00 percent.
Traders said money influx from other European emerging markets was probably the main reason behind current low overnight rates on the inter-bank market.
